summary: The v0.1.7 targeted Windows rerun confirmed that the installation version, maintenance negative-control behavior, and helper-skill visibility patch worked. It also found remaining documentation and user-gate drift issues that are useful for the next patch.

valuable_findings.finding: N3 maintenance negative control no longer mutates the installed skill.
valuable_findings.impact: Closes the clean-install contamination risk found in the v0.1.6 Windows run.

valuable_findings.finding: P3 no longer exposes host-specific helper skills.
valuable_findings.impact: Confirms the v0.1.7 helper-skill visibility rule works for the tested portfolio side-project trigger.

valuable_findings.finding: E2E PRD draft still writes candidate target user language too strongly.
valuable_findings.impact: Shows that the user-gate fix reduced but did not fully close advisor-overreach behavior.

valuable_findings.finding: README packaging docs do not directly list dist/ in the install zip exclusion list.
valuable_findings.impact: Creates a small but concrete packaging-boundary documentation gap for Windows users.

valuable_findings.finding: evaluation-package and evals.json metadata can be misread after v0.1.7.
valuable_findings.impact: Could confuse the relationship between strict-suite version, package version, and next evidence needed.

claim_boundary.supported: v0.1.7 targeted Windows rerun closed maintenance mutation and helper-skill visibility regressions, but left user-gate PRD draft drift partially open.
